name: Wojo Live Rosin | Tropic Keys
description:
The parents of this WOJO exclusive strain have won a combined 5 awards. We had a local breeder help us out with this one, and he knocked it out of the park. You'll pick up a unique mixture of fruity, gassy notes that will bring you a highly enjoyable smoking experience.

Mother: Wojo Mints 

Father: Tropic Driver

Effects: Chill, Smile

Flavor Profile: Candy 

Bred By: MIT SEED CO
